aiResearchSummary.text: Charge Robotics is researching a solar bay construction system and related methods. The solar bay construction system includes a torque tube dispensing system that places torque tubes onto a conveyor, a solar rail construction system that connects solar rails to the torque tube, and a solar panel construction system that connects panels, indicating focused development of integrated robotic systems for automated, labor intensive solar bay assembly and construction processes.
